channel.title: الترندات
channel.description: الأكثر بحثًا اليوم — Trending searches today

item.title: Giants Acquire QB J.J. McCarthy From Vikings in Surprise Trade Move
item.description: The New York Giants have traded for Minnesota Vikings quarterback J.J. McCarthy, a former first-round pick, following an injury to backup Jaxson Dart.

item.title: البرتغال تحسم الموقعة أمام النرويج برباعية هاالند.. رونالدو يراقب من المقاعد
item.description: فاز المنتخب البرتغالي على نظيره النرويجي بنتيجة 2-1 في مواجهة الدور الثاني من دوري الأمم الأوروبية، حيث سجل هاالند لكنه لم يكفِ لإنقاذ الفريق الإسكندنافي، فيما جلس النجم كريستيانو رونالدو على مقاعد البدلاء.

item.title: Daylight Saving Time Ends November 1: States Push For Permanent Shift
item.description: As clocks fall back this November, multiple U.S. states including Ohio and South Carolina are intensifying efforts to abandon the twice-yearly time change and adopt permanent daylight saving time.

item.title: SpaceX Stock Poised for Explosive Growth as Colossus AI Empire Scales to 1.44 Million GPUs
item.description: Evercore projects significant EBITDA upside for SpaceX as its Colossus supercomputer expands to 2.3–2.7GW capacity, potentially doubling revenue by 2027.

item.title: California Braces for Historic Kelvin Wave as Sea Levels Surge One Foot Higher
item.description: A slow-moving oceanic phenomenon is trapping warm water along the Pacific coast, threatening California with unprecedented coastal flooding as El Niño intensifies in 2026.

item.title: France Faces Belgium in Nations League Showdown Without Star Captain Mbappe
item.description: Two-time world champions France travel to Brussels for a crucial UEFA Nations League clash against Belgium, notably missing captain Kylian Mbappe due to injury.

item.title: Brian Burns Suffers Fresh Injury Blow As Giants Cling to Playoff Hopes
item.description: New York Giants defensive star Brian Burns went down with another injury during Week 3, leaving the team uncertain but cautiously optimistic it won't end his season.

item.title: موعد العصر اليوم بالقاهرة الساعة 16:11 ومواقيت محافظات مصر
item.description: الهيئة المصرية العامة للمساحة تحدد موعد صلاة العصر اليوم الإثنين 28 سبتمبر بـ 16:11 بالقاهرة والجيزة، مع اختلاف طفيف في المحافظات الأخرى.

item.title: FDA Recalls Common Blood Pressure Drug Over Dissolution Testing Failures
item.description: The FDA has initiated a nationwide recall of chlorthalidone medications due to failed dissolution testing, raising serious concerns about drug efficacy and patient safety.

item.title: الإمارات تحسم موقعها بثلاثية نظيفة وتتأهل لنصف النهائي
item.description: حقق المنتخب الإماراتي فوزًا كاسحًا على البحرين بثلاثة أهداف نظيفة، ليضمن التأهل إلى الدور شبه النهائي من كأس الخليج العربي.

item.title: Stock Market Tumbles As Oil Surges And Bond Yields Hit Fresh Peaks
item.description: U.S. stocks fell sharply Monday as climbing oil prices and soaring Treasury yields ignited fresh rate-hike concerns ahead of next week's critical Fed decision.

item.title: Belgium Faces France in High-Stakes Nations League Clash This Weekend
item.description: Belgium and France collide Sunday in a decisive League A Nations League matchup with playoff implications hanging in the balance.

item.title: حساب المواطن يوضح خطوات إضافة تابع جديد والموعد المتوقع للأهلية
item.description: برنامج حساب المواطن كشف عن آلية إضافة التابعين الجدد ودراسة أهليتهم ضمن دورة نوفمبر القادمة.

item.title: Slipknot Announces Massive 2027 Worldwide Stadium Tour With Major Support Acts
item.description: The heavy metal giants have unveiled an ambitious global stadium tour for 2027, featuring Marilyn Manson and Bring Me The Horizon as support acts across multiple continents.

item.title: Son Heung-min Chases Historic Record as South Korea Takes On Uruguay Tonight
item.description: Captain Son Heung-min is one goal away from matching South Korea's all-time scoring record as Coach Moreno fields a two-striker lineup against Uruguay in a high-stakes friendly at Seoul World Cup Stadium.

item.title: Taylor Sheridan's Landman Season 3 Officially Rolls Cameras in Texas
item.description: Production on Taylor Sheridan's hit oil industry drama Landman has officially commenced with cameras rolling around Fort Worth, Texas.

item.title: Ukraine Overhauls Roster With 10 Changes For Crucial Georgia UEFA Nations League Clash
item.description: Ukraine's coach Andrea Maldini made sweeping tactical adjustments with ten starting lineup changes for the high-stakes Nations League Division B match against Georgia, signaling a bold strategic shift.

item.title: البرتغال تهزم النرويج بثنائية رغم هدف هالاند في دوري الأمم الأوروبية
item.description: فاز الاختيار البرتغالي على النرويج بنتيجة 2-1 في مباراة الجولة الثانية من دوري الأمم الأوروبية، حيث أحرز هالاند للنرويج لكنه لم يكن كافياً لمنع انتصار البرتغاليين في أوسلو.

item.title: مجلس الشيوخ ينعقد الخميس.. قرار رئاسي يستعيد البرلمان لمقاعده

item.title: كوبو يقود اليابان لمواجهة فنزويلا في ودية هيروشيما اليوم
item.description: تواجه منتخب اليابان بقيادة لاعبه كوبو فريق فنزويلا في مباراة ودية بمدينة هيروشيما يشارك فيها لاعبون مميزون مثل يانجل هيريرا وخون ميكيل أرامبورو.

item.title: الأردن يتعادل مع سوريا ودياً والزاكي يشيد بنجم جديد في الهجوم
item.description: انتهت مباراة ودية بين منتخبي الأردن وسوريا بالتعادل 1-1، بينما اعتذر الاتحاد الأردني عن مشاكل البث التلفزيوني، وأشاد المدرب الزاكي باللاعب الجديد أنس العوضات.

item.title: PS5 Emulator Breakthrough: Demon's Souls Now Playable at 40-50 FPS in Three Weeks
item.description: The KyTyPS5 emulator has achieved a stunning leap from unplayable 1-2 FPS to 40-50 FPS performance, while also running the Silent Hill 2 remake on integrated graphics.

item.title: Mekhi Becton Joins Packers in Major Offensive Line Reinforcement Move
item.description: Pro lineman Mekhi Becton signs with the Green Bay Packers, reuniting with former teammate Laken Tomlinson as the team strengthens its protection.

item.title: Zimbabwe Clashes DR Congo in Tense AFCON Qualifier Battle for Group Lead
item.description: Zimbabwe and DR Congo square off in a high-stakes Matchday 2 showdown, both entering undefeated with three points and everything to play for in Group E.

item.title: Alan Ritchson's Action Thriller Dominates Global Streaming With Unstoppable 30-Day Chart Streak
item.description: Alan Ritchson's high-octane film Motor City has smashed streaming records by holding the No. 1 position for 30 consecutive days worldwide.

item.title: Trump Announces Historic $15 Billion Steel Plant in Iowa, Nation's Largest
item.description: President Trump unveiled plans for a record-breaking steel manufacturing facility in Iowa with Mesabi Metallics, poised to begin production in 2030 as a cornerstone of domestic industrial revival.

item.title: Turkey Hosts Italy in Critical UEFA Nations League Clash at Timsah Arena
item.description: Turkey and Italy face off in a high-stakes UEFA Nations League Group 1 encounter as the hosts seek to shore up defensive vulnerabilities that have plagued their recent performances.

item.title: Romania Faces Bosnia-Herzegovina in Critical UEFA Nations League Showdown
item.description: Bosnia-Herzegovina arrive in Bucharest seeking to repeat their dominant World Cup qualifying performance against Romania, with the match marking a crucial Nations League turning point for both teams.

item.title: مواجهة حاسمة بسول.. كوريا وأوروغواي يبحثان عن النصر والعودة

item.title: فرنسا تختتم تحضيراتها في بروكسل قبل مواجهة بلجيكا الليلة

item.title: فرنسا تواجه بلجيكا بدون مبابي.. من سيقود الهجوم الفرنسي؟

item.title: Fat Bear Week Returns: Alaska's Heavyweight Champions Battle for Internet Glory

item.title: The Witcher 3 Remastered Launches Globally With 45GB Update and Review Embargo
item.description: CD Projekt Red's highly anticipated Witcher 3 Remastered is rolling out worldwide with a massive 45GB patch, confirmed release times, and critics' verdicts arriving simultaneously.

item.title: Trump Renames Kennedy Center as Senator Pushes Ban on Living Politicians' Buildings
item.description: Senator John Kennedy proposes barring living politicians from having buildings named after them after Trump moves to rename the iconic Kennedy Center.

item.title: Medvedev Powers Into Hangzhou Semifinals, Faces Fellow Russian Safiullin
item.description: World-class competitor Daniil Medvedev advanced to the ATP Hangzhou Open semifinals, setting up a high-stakes all-Russian showdown against Roman Safiullin.
